reason_catalog.B1_term_not_in_example: No declared discriminating term occurs in the reviewed example or translation.
reason_catalog.B2_rationale_not_distinct: Review rationales or notes are insufficiently individualized.
reason_catalog.B2_rationale_not_grounded: A rationale or note does not quote or name evidence from its target.
reason_catalog.B3_attribution_copy_pattern: Attribution term diversity indicates copying from sense labels rather than example reading.
reason_catalog.B4_zero_finding_single_review: A zero-finding run lacks the required second-model confirmation.
